notes: All values read from the listed pages on 2026-09-26. Where a firm's own pages conflict, the conflict is noted in the plan's notes/price_alternatives. Prices are USD before tax.

firms.product_notes: Futures only, no forex/swing trading. Products marked * on the help page (MES, MNQ, M2K, MBT, MET, M6E, M6A, 6M, MCL, MYM, MGC, SIL) point to Prohibited Conduct, but the current Prohibited Conduct text names no product-specific rule. Current volatility restrictions (Risk Adjustments article), as $50K/$100K/$150K limits: SI=0, HG=0, PL=0 (not tradable). RB/HO/CL/QM capped at 3/6/9. MCL 30/60/90 (LFA 3/6/9). GC 3/6/9. MGC 30/60/90 (LFA 5/10/15). SIL and MHG 2/4/6. The Scaling Plan also applies in the XFA. Micro:mini ratio is 10:1, except SIL (5:1 vs SI, counts as 2 micros) and MBT/MET (capped at mini-equivalent lot sizes). CPI release: 5 min before to 5 min after, no new opening trades in ES, RTY, YM, NQ, NKD, GC, SI, HG, PL minis. Opening micros (MES, M2K, MYM, MNQ, MGC, SIL, MHG) are capped at 1/3/6/9/15 for the 25K/50K/100K/150K/250K sizes. Session is 5:00 PM to 3:10 PM CT, and you must be flat by 3:10 PM CT (Risk begins flattening at 3:08 PM CT). CBOT grains (ZC, ZW, ZS, ZM, ZL) trade 8:30 AM to 1:20 PM CT on Mon-Fri and 7:00 PM to 7:45 AM CT on Sun-Mon. HE/LE trade 8:30 AM to 1:05 PM CT. You must exit before a product's own earlier close.
firms.commission_notes: All-in round-turn per contract on TopstepX (TC, XFA and LFA): exchange fee + $0.02 NFA + commission ($1.00 minis, $0.50 micros). From the Oct 1, 2026 trading day CME raises exchange fees: MCL goes to $0.60/side and MNG to $0.70/side (+$0.20 RT each). That would make the all-in totals MCL $1.72 and MNG $1.92. Those two totals are my arithmetic and are not printed on the page.

account_limits.max_funded_accounts: 5 active XFAs (mix of sizes/paths OK; extra passes go on hold); 1 Live Funded Account (all XFAs close on call-up); 1 Pro Account; Focused Trader Program limits to 1 active $50K account

firms.other_rules: Prohibited: account stacking, trading outside best bid/offer, cross-account hedging, coordinated trading, SIM-fill exploitation (HFT/tight brackets), holding within 2% of price limit, VPNs. Inactivity >30 days may close XFA/LFA. Automated trading allowed (API on SIM only).

firms.product_notes: CME/CBOT/COMEX/NYMEX list from the help article 'Which symbols/instruments can I trade'. These are NOT on the list: interest-rate futures (ZT/ZF/ZN/ZB/UB/TN), NKD, HO, PL, crypto (MBT/MET), E7/M6E/M6B/6M. Micro:mini ratio for mixing is 1:10 for Legacy, Flex and Rapid Pro/Daily (1:3 Bolt, 1:5 old Rapid, both discontinued). Must be flat by 3:10 PM CT Mon-Fri (auto-closed), with trading resuming 5:00 PM CT. No overnight or weekend holds. News trading allowed in Challenge and FundedNext Account. Trading within 2% of CME price limits is prohibited, as is trading gapped/illiquid markets. Micro-scalping (trades closed within 10s): a warning at 30% of cycle profit. At 40%, advancement is held (Challenge) or that profit is deducted (funded).
firms.commission_notes: No per-product table is published. The help article says costs are the 'all-in rate' (NinjaTrader commission + exchange/NFA + clearing), charged per side, and links to ninjatrader.com/pricing/commissions. Its worked example uses NQ at $2.88 per side, which is $5.76 per round turn. The NQ value here comes only from that example.

firms.other_rules: One-time fees, no monthly subscription, no activation fee. The DLL is a soft breach and the MLL is a hard breach (evaluated on real-time equity against the EOD-trailing level). Old 'Rapid' and 'Bolt' models are discontinued since 10 Jul 2026 (existing accounts may keep trading, no resets). Labs FNL:003 50K Instant Account ($149.99, 90% share, 20% perpetual consistency, $2,100 buffer, $800-$1,200 withdrawals) is marked 'Expired' on fundednext.com/labs. Payout processing fee is up to 3.5%. Crypto withdrawals are capped at $1,999 each.
